relations: Still water mirrors the tree canopy, so any breeze-induced ripple would distort the reflected shapes.
Sunlit foliage on the right bank casts bright green tones that persist on the water as light shifts.
Exposed rocks near the far shore remain fixed while slow current may carry floating leaves past them.
A fallen branch resting on the right bank stays in place unless water level rises around it.
